#Module webassembly

The WebAssembly JavaScript API (src/page/webassembly.odin, the objects: native/js/odin/web_wasm.odin): a page's own WebAssembly modules, compiled and run by Wasmtime beside the engine's. Off until it is complete (javascript.webassembly.enabled): a page that finds a WebAssembly object expects all of it.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/webassembly.widl.

#Types

#handle WebAssemblyModule : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_WebAssemblyModule).

#Functions

#WebAssembly_enabled

bool WebAssembly_enabled()

Whether the page's realm has the WebAssembly object (javascript.webassembly.enabled).

Host: WebAssembly_enabled :: proc(c: ^Call) -> bool

#WebAssembly_validate

bool WebAssembly_validate(bytes module)

WebAssembly.validate(bytes): whether bytes is a valid module.

Host: WebAssembly_validate :: proc(c: ^Call, module: []u8) -> bool

#WebAssembly_compile

WebAssemblyModule WebAssembly_compile(bytes module) raises

new WebAssembly.Module(bytes): bytes compiled. Syntax with the reason when it is not a valid module, Security when the page's Content Security Policy refuses it.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: WebAssembly_compile :: proc(c: ^Call, module: []u8) -> (u64, Api_Error)

WebAssembly.Module.imports(module), as JSON.

Host: WebAssembly_Module_imports :: proc(c: ^Call, module: Api_WebAssemblyModule) -> string

How many custom sections of the module are called name.
